messages:
Maria G.: Quick heads-up — I plan to pin semver for the next cut across API, runtime, console, and SDK today. Need a quick handshake on vendored deps and lockfile strategy. ETA: 3pm PT.
Alex P.: Which exact repos/branches are we targeting? main or release/*?
Maria G.: Target list: api-server@main, runtime@release/v2, console@main, js-sdk@main. We want a coordinated tag and changelog entry.
Jordan K.: Can we do a hard cutoff window? propose 2:30–3:30pm PT where no non-bump merges happen. I'll post a calendar invite. :calendar:
Sam T.: For the js-sdk, I still have an open PR touching auth headers. Should I hold it until after bump?
Maria G.: hold it if it changes public surface. If it's tiny, mark as post-bump patch and ping me.
Kevin L.: Question on lockfiles — runtime repo vendors a few native deps. Do we update lockfile in the same PR as the version bump or a separate dep bump PR?
Alex P.: I'd prefer separate dep-bump PRs for clarity, but we should tag them so the CI gating doesn't block the release tag.
Sam T.: ok I can open a dep-bump PR for js-sdk now and mark it "do-not-merge/during-release".
Maria G.: Good. Plan: 1) open version-bump PRs with changelog entry 2) open dep-bump PRs if needed and flag them 3) freeze merges during the 2:30–3:30 window 4) tag v2.4.0 across repos when green.
Jordan K.: I'll add a checklist in the release thread with timestamps and who tags what.
Kevin L.: For tagging, let's use lightweight tags then follow with annotated tags for release notes? I can handle annotated tags for runtime. Example commands:
```
# create annotated tag
git tag -a v2.4.0 -m "release v2.4.0"
git push origin refs/tags/v2.4.0
```
Alex P.: For SDKs we push npm dist-tags after tag. Sample: `npm publish --tag next` then `npm dist-tag add @redwood/js-sdk@2.4.0 latest`.
Maria G.: Great. @deploy-bot can we get a reminder 10m before freeze starts?
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — will post to #eng-releases at 14:20 PT.
Sam T.: One more: who writes the final consolidated changelog? I'd volunteer but want a quick review from API and runtime owners.
Maria G.: Thanks Sam — please draft the consolidated changelog and ping @Alex P., @Kevin L. for quick review.
Alex P.: ack, will review by 2:45pm.
Maria G.: Perfect. If any repo can't make it in the window, post here ASAP and we'll fallback to staggered rollouts. :thumbsup:
